title: Attention message-recovery context
description: Schema for .scrum/attention-context.json. Holds the most recent turn ending seen by the Stop hook so that a following idle_prompt Notification — whose own message is generic — can be shown with Claude's actual closing text. Overwritten on every Stop, from any session, so a mismatch on prompt_id is expected and simply falls back to the Notification's own message. Writers: hooks/notification-attention.sh only (no .scrum/scripts/*.sh wrapper — hook hot-path).

prompt_id.description: The Stop payload's prompt_id. The following Notification for the same turn carries an identical prompt_id; that equality is the match condition. Empty string when the payload carried none, which never matches (the writer requires both sides non-empty).

last_assistant_message.description: The turn's final assistant message, truncated to 200 codepoints plus an ellipsis. Empty string when the payload carried none.

recorded_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the Stop that produced this record.
